name: 07-leaf-to-field
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE deeply concept-driven logo for 禾观 AgriScan, a crop health app that analyzes a leaf photograph and links the observation to a field record. The concept is 一叶知田: understand the field through a single leaf. The idea MUST be evident in the actual visual construction, not just agricultural decoration.
Design ONE elegantly shaped broad upright leaf, softly asymmetrical and slightly tilted. Its interior negative-space vein structure should unmistakably form the Chinese character 田: a compact rounded rectangular paddy-field grid with a central cross, subtly integrated into the lower two thirds of the leaf. The leaf's central vein flows seamlessly into the grid's vertical divider, and a short top vein continues up into the leaf tip. This is a clever figure-ground union of leaf and field, not a leaf pasted on farmland. Aim for a distinctive warm Chinese contemporary emblem, balanced medium complexity and carefully crafted shapes. A small warm-gold section in ONE quadrant represents the local observation within the whole field, restrained and integral, not ornamental. Solid forest green and muted harvest gold only, clean warm ivory negative space and background. Thoughtful organic geometry with lightly rounded joins. Compact enough for an app icon yet recognizably authored, not generic clip art. The user disliked the corporate eye logo, plain sprouts, mascot faces and arbitrary farm scenery. No eye, no magnifier, no mascot, no sun, no arch frame, no shield, no swoosh, no gradients, no shadows, no textures, no 3D, no lettering, no slogans, no annotations, no mockups. Single finished symbol centered on square warm ivory canvas, generous margin.

name: 08-observation-record
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE concept-driven logo for 禾观 AgriScan, a crop-health app that turns each leaf photograph into a saved observation, so users can follow changes in their crops over time. Concept: 观察有迹 — every leaf observation becomes a lasting growth record. The design MUST communicate this through visual relationships.
Invent ONE unified symbol which is simultaneously an organic leaf and an open two-page field notebook. The notebook's left page is a broad upright rounded leaf silhouette in forest green. The right page is a smaller outward-curving leaf/page in muted sage. A single crisp ivory curved central seam is BOTH the leaf midrib AND book binding. Within the right page, THREE short horizontal rounded negative-space strokes of subtly increasing length suggest sequential saved observations; the uppermost stroke ends in ONE small integral warm grain-gold seed dot, representing the latest recorded observation. The two lower page edges gently converge at the binding, giving the whole leaf-book a graceful modest V-shaped base. Strong conceptual figure-ground design, recognizable leaf and record-book on first inspection, not two unrelated stock icons. Medium detail, mature warm editorial identity, thoughtfully asymmetrical, credible but approachable, not corporate and not childish. Exactly forest green, sage, tiny warm-gold accent on plain warm ivory background. Flat crisp shapes, no gradients, shadows, textures, mockups, 3D, eye, magnifier, mascot, generic sprout, sun, landscape, shield, enclosing badge, text or annotations. One finished logo mark only, centered square composition with generous margin.
